rewrites.//: SPA fallback. Must exclude service workers and static assets so Vercel serves them literally instead of returning index.html with text/html (which breaks ServiceWorker registration with a MIME error).

headers.//: Force the OneSignal service worker to be served with a real JS MIME type and the Service-Worker-Allowed header so it can claim the root scope. Combined with the rewrite exclusion above, this is the scorched-earth fix for the text/html -> SecurityError cascade that corrupted IndexedDB with local-<uuid> IDs.
